hotelReviewSummaryFromAi.positive: Great value for money centrally located hotel in Da Nang, surrounded by dining and shopping options, short walk to the beach. Friendly and accommodating staff with clean and modern rooms. The hotel offers fantastic facilities including rooftop infinity pool, gym, and sauna. Enjoy a delicious breakfast buffet with Vietnamese, Chinese, and Japanese options.
hotelReviewSummaryFromAi.negative: Some guests have reported noise from the street and thin walls, which can make it difficult to sleep despite the efforts of the hotel's sound-proof system.

description.short: Perched above Da Nang with sweeping sea and city views, Golden Lotus Grand offers two travelers a sky-high infinity rooftop pool and bar, chic afternoon tea, Instagrammable design, lively rooftop events, and boutique beachfront access to My Khe surf and local seafood eateries. In relaxed Phước Mỹ, this hotel combines cliffside calm with city convenience—panoramic pool, rooftop cocktail bar, and private beach with a short walk to My Khe. Rooms include air conditioning, free Wi‑Fi, modern showers, premium toiletries, and private balconies or terraces in selected units. Bookable extras: guided island tours and a soothing sauna. Danang Night Market and Son Tra Night Market are nearby for evening eats and local finds—ideal for two travelers seeking beach time, food and photo-ready stays.
